Name: Adjustable Laptop Stand
Description: Ergonomics without the ugly aluminum clutter. Engineered in structural PETG to handle heavy workstations without flexing, then folds flat into your bag.
Care: Tell us your laptop size and we will calibrate hinge tension to match.

Name: Architectural Scale Model
Description: Scale models from floor plans and BIM exports. Tangible volume and sightline verification for client pitches, planning reviews and public exhibits.
Care: Send DWG, IFC, or 3D CAD files for a structural estimate.

Name: Articulated Flexi Dragon
Note: Moves and twists like a toy
Description: A dragon with a bendy, jointed body, printed in one piece. It wiggles, twists and makes a great gift.
Uses: Children's gifts, Desk fidget, Party prizes
Care: Pick your colours when you order.

Name: Big Five Animal Set
Description: Lion, elephant, buffalo, rhino and leopard. Minimalist geometric figurines with substantial weight, designed and printed in Kenya.
Care: Hand-painted accent coats available on request.

Name: Branded Logo Sign
Description: Your brand deserves better than a blurry logo on cheap paper. We turn flat vector marks into raised, weighted 3D signs for reception desks, feature walls and showroom counters.
Uses: Reception walls, Retail counters, Exhibition booths
Care: Send vector assets (SVG, AI, PDF) or high-res files. We match your Pantone or hex brand colours.

Name: Cable & Desk Organiser
Description: A desktop anchor with custom channels to keep your charging cords from diving behind your desk every time you unplug.
Care: Custom debossed company logos available for team batches.

Name: Custom Desk Nameplate
Description: Establish desk territory with sharp, two-tone raised typography. Because a folded piece of paper taped to a display is an insult to your title.
Uses: Executive desks, New hire onboarding, Team promotions
Care: Send team roster, titles and brand colours. Batch pricing kicks in automatically for teams.

Name: Custom PETG Bracket
Description: Structural mounting brackets printed in chemical and UV-resistant PETG, oriented along the stress axis for maximum layer adhesion.
Uses: Equipment mounting, Vehicle brackets, Industrial repairs
Care: Send force load requirements and bolt dimensions.

Name: Geometric Spiral Vase
Description: A twisted, textured vase that looks hand-sculpted. Great for dried stems and faux flowers, and a lovely housewarming gift.
Uses: Housewarming gift, Shelf or table centrepiece, Dried flowers
Care: Made for dry arrangements. Prints are not watertight unless made for it, so ask us if you want fresh flowers.

Name: Kenya Map Keychain
Description: A pocket-sized silhouette of Kenya. Precise perimeter cuts, durable infill, and zero cheap plastic feel.
Care: Volume batch discounts apply automatically for events.

Name: Kenya Topographic Relief Map
Description: A layered relief of Kenya's highlands, Great Rift Valley and coast. Real geographical contour data, translated into tactile physical art.
Uses: Diaspora gift, Boardrooms & lobbies, Geography collections
Care: Larger custom dimensions quoted on request.

Name: Lithophane Photo Lamp
Description: Optical physics in action: variable layer thickness translates grayscale photo pixels into light density. An unassuming white relief until the light turns on.
Care: Send a clear, high-contrast photo. Backlit LEDs included.

Name: Personalised Name Keychain
Description: Custom raised lettering fused directly into the base layer so the letters never peel or snap off.
Care: Send names and hex colors. Larger batches cost significantly less per piece.

Name: Phone & Headphone Dock
Description: One tidy spot for your phone and headphones, with a channel that keeps the charging cable neat.
Uses: Desk or bedside, Branded team gift, Reception counter
Care: Tell us your phone model so the cable channel fits.

Name: Rapid Prototype Print
Description: Simulations lie. Physics does not. Hold your part, test bolt hole tolerances, check clearances, and catch design flaws before ordering tooling.
Uses: Tolerance checks, Fit testing, Investor demos
Care: Send STEP, STL or 3MF. We verify manifold geometry and wall thickness before slicing.

Name: Replacement Spare Parts
Description: Manufacturers want you to discard a perfectly good machine because a 50-shilling nylon gear broke. We disagree. Send the broken fragment.
Care: Bring or courier the broken original so we can gauge dimensions with vernier calipers.

Name: STEM Learning Models
Description: Physical mechanics you can disassemble: planetary gearboxes, crystal lattices, and anatomical cross-sections that make abstract physics obvious.
Care: Curriculum-aligned bulk sets available on request.

Name: Succulent Planter Set
Description: Three planters in graduated sizes with drainage holes and matching saucers. Ask about a set as table favours for an event.
Care: PETG is the better pick if the planters will sit outdoors.
